name: Geralt of Rivia
shortDescription: The White Wolf. Mutated witcher and master swordsman.
fullDescription: Geralt of Rivia is a witcher, a mutant monster-hunter trained from childhood to fight monsters. He travels the Continent, taking contracts and facing difficult choices.

fullDescription: Cirilla Fiona Elen Riannon is the princess of Cintra and a powerful source of Elder Blood...
